answer: # Scarce-Resource Proof of Storage Each agent identity must continuously host a randomly assigned, erasure-coded shard of a shared public archive. A lotus-shaped audit cadence—challenge queries issued at unpredictable intervals—forces the agent to prove the shard is retrievable on demand; failure revokes the identity. The archive is seeded across holders from a willow of independent origins, so no single source can forge retrievability proofs alone. Attacker cost: each identity needs a physical wharf of storage with real bandwidth and uptime,
